youtube.caption:
Napoleon got removed from the group. He did NOT stay removed 😎

What's the pettiest way YOU ever got back into a group chat? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 1814 the Allies exiled Napoleon to the tiny island of Elba. In February 1815 he escaped, landed in France and was back in Paris on 20 March. After Waterloo they sent him to St Helena, in the middle of the South Atlantic.
